Elena — thanks for the clear list and great meeting yesterday. We're aligned and can hit your timeline. Quick responses inline below and artifacts attached.

- DPA: attaching our latest executed DPA template (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf). If you need countersignature, let us know who will sign on your side and we'll route for e-sign.
- SOC 2: we don't attach the full report in public threads; sharing a protected link — included in the "SOC2_report_link.txt" attachment (sits behind our viewer access). If you need a copy for legal review we can set a temporary viewer token.
- Subprocessors: included in the DPA appendix and summarized in the attached playbook. Key data flows and EU transfer mechanisms (SCCs + assessment) are called out on page 3.
- PO wiring & reference: Redwood requires PO to reference the Redwood order id (we'll provide once invoice/activation is agreed). Billing contact: billing@redwood.com; remittance: Redwood Inference, 350 3rd St, Suite 210, San Francisco, CA 94103. For faster processing, please cc procurement@redwood.com and accounts-payable@redwood.com on the PO email.

I've attached a short "Vendor Onboarding Playbook" (see Drive link below) that lists the steps our AP team needs so we can get you live. Ben — can you confirm whether we require a signed DPA before activation on our hosted trial or if the playbook checklist is sufficient?
